notice.body: Reconnect this bot to restore GitHub reviews and @mentions. Start with the App already saved in Paperclip.

recovery.restoreAfter: using its saved credentials. Paperclip will check the App and its installation, then repair event delivery.
recovery.staysAttached: Your agent, repository choices, review settings, and task history stay attached to this connection. You don’t need to create another GitHub App.

errors.reconnectFailed: Could not reconnect GitHub. Try again.
errors.secretChangedUnseen: The webhook secret changed, but this page did not receive it. Generate another secret and update GitHub.
errors.generateFailed: Could not generate the webhook secret. Try again.
errors.reconnectSavedTitle: Could not reconnect the saved App
errors.rotationHint: Use the newest secret in GitHub App settings, then retry reconnecting after GitHub verifies delivery.
errors.reconnectHint: Try again if the service is temporarily unavailable. If GitHub rejected the saved key, replace the credentials for this same App below.

rotation.title: Rotate the webhook secret
rotation.committed: The rotated secret is saved. Reconnect using that value; Paperclip will check GitHub’s signed delivery.
rotation.instructionsBefore: Generate a new secret, then replace the webhook secret in
rotation.instructionsAfter: . GitHub must verify the new secret before you reconnect.
rotation.warning: Generating immediately invalidates the previous secret. This value is shown only here; keep this page open until you have copied it.
rotation.uncertain: The active secret is not confirmed. Check its saved status before using an earlier value.

credentials.titleReplace: Replace credentials for the same App
credentials.orgOwned: If it’s owned by an organization, open that organization’s Settings → Developer settings → GitHub Apps → Edit. You’ll need permission to manage the App.
credentials.requested: Enter the requested credentials below. Other saved credentials stay in place.

appId.label: App ID
appId.help: The numeric App ID on the GitHub App’s settings page. This is different from its Client ID or installation ID.
appId.savedFilled: The saved ID is filled in when available.
appId.invalid: Use the numeric App ID, not the Client ID.

privateKey.label: Private key
privateKey.help: Upload the .pem file downloaded from this GitHub App, or paste its entire contents, including the BEGIN and END lines.
privateKey.step1Before: In the same App’s settings, open
privateKey.step1Middle: . On the older settings page, use
privateKey.step1OldPath: Private keys → Generate a private key
privateKey.step2After: file below, or paste its entire contents.
privateKey.reuse: You can reuse a .pem file you already saved. GitHub cannot show an old private key again. Creating a new key for the same App keeps its installation.
privateKey.readFailed: Could not read this file. Try again or paste the key below.
privateKey.paste: Or paste the complete PEM key
privateKey.loaded: Private key loaded. Paste or upload another key to replace it.
privateKey.invalid: Use a PEM private key, including its BEGIN and END lines. A token or client secret won’t work here.

webhookSecret.label: Webhook secret
webhookSecret.help: The secret configured for this App’s webhook. It must match GitHub exactly.
webhookSecret.body: Use the secret saved when you configured this App’s webhook. If you no longer have it, change the webhook secret in GitHub App settings and enter the same value here.

clientSecret.label: Client secret
clientSecret.help: The client secret for this GitHub App’s user authentication. Leave the saved private key in place.
